questions.q: I'm not used to ___ in an open-plan office.
questions.explainRo: După **be used to** urmează verbul cu **-ing**.

questions.q: When I got to the station, the train ___, so I took a taxi.
questions.explainRo: Trenul plecase înainte de sosirea mea: **past perfect**.

questions.q: Don't rush – we've got ___ time before the meeting starts.
questions.explainRo: **A little** + substantiv nenumărabil (time), cu sens pozitiv.

questions.q: By the end of the quarter, we ___ three new features.
questions.explainRo: **By + moment viitor** cere **future perfect**: will have shipped.

questions.q: I didn't repair my laptop myself – I ___ at a shop near the office.
questions.explainRo: **Have + obiect + V3** = altcineva a făcut acțiunea pentru mine.

questions.q: I wish I ___ that email to the whole company. It was so embarrassing.
He ___ my message – his phone was switched off all day.
questions.explainRo: Este aproape imposibil, deci folosim **can't have + V3**.

questions.q: The client insisted ___ a fixed price for the whole project.
On the way to the airport, we stopped ___ some petrol.
questions.explainRo: **Stop + to + infinitiv** = te oprești ca să faci altceva.

questions.q: The manager to ___ I sent the proposal hasn't replied yet.
If I had learnt English at school, I ___ more international clients now.
questions.explainRo: Condițional mixt: cauză în trecut (had learnt), efect în prezent (**would have** + now).

questions.q: Not only ___ cheaper, but it is also much faster.
questions.explainRo: După **Not only** la începutul propoziției urmează inversiunea: **is the new system**.
